sentences.englishText: There are several cinemas showing different films such as "Long Live Life" and "Separate Rooms".
sentences.turkishText: "Yaşasın Yaşam" ve "Ayrı Odalar" gibi farklı filmler gösteren birkaç sinema bulunmaktadır.

sentences.englishText: The film "The Color Purple" is showing at Cinema West with multiple screenings throughout the day.
sentences.turkishText: "Mor Renk" filmi, gün boyu birden fazla gösterimle Cinema West'te gösterilmektedir.

sentences.englishText: Some films have age restrictions, so viewers should check the minimum age before buying tickets.
sentences.turkishText: Bazı filmlerin yaş sınırı vardır, bu yüzde izleyiciler bilet almadan önce minimum yaşı kontrol etmelidir.

enrichment.summary: There are several cinemas showing different films such as "Long Live Life" and "Separate Rooms". The film "The Color Purple" is showing at Cinema West with multiple screenings throughout the day.
